queries.sql: SELECT @@port AS port,@@datadir AS datadir,@@server_uuid AS uuid,DATABASE() AS db;

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE status='ON_SALE') AS on_sale,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE status='DRAFT') AS draft,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_order WHERE status='PAID') AS paid,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_user WHERE role='CUSTOMER' AND status='ENABLED') AS enabled_customers,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_user WHERE role='CUSTOMER' AND status='DISABLED') AS disabled_customers;
SELECT p.id,p.sku,p.name,p.version,0 AS image_count FROM product p WHERE p.status='ON_SALE' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM product_image pi WHERE pi.product_id=p.id) ORDER BY p.id LIMIT 1;
